comparator.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 programme-specific OER defines a 180-EC programme with 60 EC of General Education, a main direction of 67.5–105 EC and the balance as profiling space. General Education comprises four compulsory 7.5-EC LAS courses and 30 EC of electives split equally across the two science groups outside the chosen main direction. The generic target does not choose among the formal main directions, so the first current direction on the prospective-student list, Film- en televisiewetenschap (group A), is selected by official-order tie-break. A minimum-size 67.5-EC main direction is instantiated, including its required 7.5-EC final work, leaving 52.5 EC of open profiling space. The programme also requires a zero-credit portfolio, which is recorded here but does not alter the 180-EC total.

notes.text: Utrecht LAS combines a compulsory interdisciplinary core with a formally approved main direction, two General Education fields, profiling space, a programme thesis and a separate main-direction final work.
